About us

Protecting Homes. Securing Businesses. Delivering Results.

W.L PEST CONTROL LLC is a Grayson, Georgia pest control company serving homes and businesses across the Greater Atlanta area. Our certified, licensed technicians use high-quality products for real results — from one-time treatments to year-round protection plans.

From German roaches and bed bugs to termites, rodents, and stinging insects, we handle the pests other companies miss — safely around your kids, pets, customers, and staff.

How It Works

No guesswork, no over-spraying — just a clear plan that gets rid of pests and keeps them gone.

1

Thorough Inspection

We inspect your property to identify the pest, find the source, and locate the entry points they’re using.

2

Targeted Treatment

Safe, targeted treatments matched to the pest and your property — homes, businesses, and sensitive sites like schools and daycares.

3

Ongoing Protection

Monthly maintenance programs, exclusion work, and seal-up services keep pests from coming back — year-round peace of mind.
